notReleased.Cargo.toml: the root Cargo workspace of the core crate and the binding crates (binding design L-2)
notReleased.legacy/packages/js/package.json: the legacy language package of the transition, which is no release target until it is removed (docs/spec/php-serialize.md#transition)
notReleased.legacy/packages/python/pyproject.toml: the legacy language package of the transition, which is no release target until it is removed (docs/spec/php-serialize.md#transition)
notReleased.packages/go/go.mod: the Go module of the binding: make release-go-module carries it in a commit and the tag packages/go/vX.Y.Z of its own with the static library of each platform (binding GN-19f), which kit does not make, so goModules names no module and no tag of kit releases it
